description: This file implements an Azure Speech-to-Text service class for real-time audio transcription within the Pipecat project, utilizing Azure Cognitive Services SDK. It includes methods for starting, stopping, and handling recognition events, and integrates with project-specific frames and utilities.

classes.name: AzureSTTService
classes.description: Implements Azure Cognitive Services Speech SDK for real-time speech recognition, managing audio streams, recognition events, and integration with project frames.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AzureSTTService with API key, region, language, sample rate, and optional endpoint ID.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Processes incoming audio bytes, feeds them to the recognizer, and yields frames or errors.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the speech recognition process, setting up audio streams and recognizer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition process and closes resources.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels recognition immediately and releases resources.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription results with tracing, stops metrics collection.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognized
methods.description: Callback for recognized speech events, creates transcription frames.

methods.name: _on_handle_recognizing
methods.description: Callback for interim recognition events, creates interim transcription frames.
